meta.name: Helios design tokens
meta.source: web/src/index.css, plus the two print tokens defined in design/BRAND.md section 4
meta.note: Single source of truth. The CSS and Tailwind snippets under design/brand/tokens/ are exports of this file, not parallel definitions.

mintPrint.use: the disc in light and print contexts; mint fails on white at 1.6:1

mutedPrint.use: the rule in light and print contexts

state._constraint: Product state only: a marker outside its band, and a dead sync. Off limits to the identity in every context.

identity._constraint: The mark uses two colours and never a third.

markGeometry.clearSpace: one disc radius (0.5 x disc diameter) on all sides
markGeometry._criticalValue: gap. It is what separates the mark from a hyphenated dot. Do not close it, do not double it.

minSizes._note: At 18px and below use design/brand/menubar/HeliosTemplate.svg, the optical redraw, not a scaled icon.

lockupMetrics.alignment: near the x-height centre, not the block centre

type.wordmark: original geometric construction, outlined paths, never live text

rules: the mark holds no opinion about the person using it
no arc reading as percentage complete, no upward direction, no tick, no face
mint is spent only on shapes with no valence: a disc, a tick, a baseline
never mint on a direction, an arrow, a rising line, or a closing arc
caution and alert are product state, never identity
the rule is a horizon: never rotate the mark
